verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs have a dedicated voice-chat feature page stating you can talk to Khoj using your voice, with queries answered by the same models as text chat. That covers voice input, but the evidence is thin and doesn't show the rest of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of spoken (TTS) replies, live real-time voice conversation mode, voice-note transcription on messaging surfaces like WhatsApp, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
